verdict.rationale: Better Auth documents defining roles and permissions through its organization plugin ("Assign roles and permissions", "access control") and role management in the admin plugin, and a community user confirms RBAC support. The JWT plugin issues tokens, but nothing in the evidence shows roles or permissions being included in session tokens, and enforcement of permission checks is only implied. Missing for 10: documented custom permission definitions and server-side enforcement APIs, evidence that roles/permissions are surfaced in session or JWT claims, hands-on corroboration of authorization checks.
